title: Laki extension (widget.json)
description: A Laki extension: what it fetches, how often, where it shows and what it draws (ui). https://github.com/igorkasyanchuk/laki/blob/main/docs/extensions.md

description.description: A line about it, in Settings

size.description: Cells across (1-3) and down (½, 1-4) in the sidebar; across in a bar

view.description: Its full view’s size: s, m (the default) or l

anyOf.description: side (the sidebar), top or status (a bar, a line high), rail or foot (a button), desk (the Desk), panel (a tab in the right panel), row (a mark on each workspace’s row: per workspace only)

items.description: side (the sidebar), top or status (a bar, a line high), rail or foot (a button), desk (the Desk), panel (a tab in the right panel), row (a mark on each workspace’s row: per workspace only)

place.description: Where it shows at first (the user’s choice wins): one place or several

scope.description: global (the default): one for the app; workspace: one per workspace, its fetch given $LAKI_BRANCH, $PORT, $LAKI_PATH… and its ui {{workspace.branch}}

on.description: Events it answers: { "turn.done": "one of its actions" | "refresh" }; the handler gets the event as JSON on stdin and in $LAKI_EVENT_FILE, its name as $LAKI_EVENT

stream.description: Its fetch runs all along: each line of JSON it prints is its data (every is ignored; global only)

fetch.description: A shell command in its folder; what it prints (JSON) is its data. $WIDGET_<NAME> per setting, $LAKI_WIDGET_CONFIG, $LAKI_REFRESH_REASON

script.description: Or a JS file of its folder: its default export gets { config, last, workspace } and returns the data

additionalProperties.description: A setting: its default (text; a number, true/false or a list make that kind), or a spec

type.description: text, number, bool (a switch), choice (one of choices), list (chips) or secret (a token: kept out of the app, given only to its fetch and actions)

required.description: It needs one: while it is empty its cell says Set <label> and opens its settings

config.description: Its settings, by name (a letter or _, then letters, digits, _)

title.description: Its label in menus and the palette (unset: its name in words)

show.description: Where it’s offered: palette (⌘K), workspace (a workspace’s ⋯ and right click), tab (a tab’s right click), file (a file’s right click in Files, by match), prompt (a prompt box’s Insert menu)

match.description: With file: the files it’s for, as globs (*.ts, docs/**/*.md; one without / matches the name); unset: every file

key.description: A shortcut that runs it with the workspace and tab you’re in: Alt+Cmd+E (with Alt: Cmd and Cmd+Shift alone are Laki’s, Ctrl alone a terminal’s)

ask.description: A question asked first; the answer is its $WIDGET_ARG

confirm.description: A yes or no asked first ("Run it on the whole workspace?")

insert.description: What it prints (its JSON’s "insert", else all of it) goes into the prompt: the box it was picked in, else the focused agent’s, unsent

view.description: Its full view opens after it runs: a file opener (show file, its data from what it prints as { "data" })

tool.description: Agents may call it as a tool (laki widget tool, MCP, Laki AI)

description.description: What it does, for the agent

input.description: Its fields: a type (string, number, boolean, string[]) or { type, description, enum }; each as $WIDGET_INPUT_<NAME>, all as $WIDGET_ARG (JSON)

ask.description: first (the default): asked once per workspace; always: every call; never

ai.description: An agent answers this prompt ({{arg}}, {{config.x}}, {{data.x}}, {{workspace.branch}} filled in), with the user’s own MCP servers; its answer shows in a dialog, or its json block’s { "toast" }, { "modal" } or { "data" }

tools.description: Claude’s tools it may use unasked, by name, comma-separated (mcp__slack__post_message); others are refused

profile.description: A claude or codex profile (unset: Settings › Extensions’ agent)

actions.description: Commands its buttons run by name, with $WIDGET_ARG: a command, { "run", "tool" } (agents may call it), or { "ai": a prompt } (an agent answers it); what one prints as JSON may say { "toast" }, { "modal" }, { "data" } or { "insert" }. title, show, match, key, ask, confirm, insert and view offer it in the palette, menus, a shortcut and the prompt, with $LAKI_CTX (the workspace, tab or file it was picked on)

notify.description: A notification, a template over its data ("{{#if mentions}}{{mentions}} new mentions{{/if}}"): posted when it reads as something new after a fetch, not empty and not what it last said

icon.description: As a button: an icon of Laki’s by name, or an emoji

label.description: As a button: its words, a template over its data

badge.description: As a button: a short count, a template ("{{#if n}}{{n}}{{/if}}")

click.description: One of its actions, run on a click on its button

kind.description: fetch: its own fetch or script; static: the text below; file: a file read each time (JSON, else { "text" }); url: an http(s) page read each time; ai: an agent (claude or codex, with the user’s own MCP servers) answers prompt, its last ```json block the data

text.description: With static: JSON, or words (its data: { "text" })

path.description: With file: its path (~ is home; relative: the extension’s folder; {{config.x}}, {{workspace.path}})

prompt.description: With ai: what the agent finds and sums up ({{config.x}}, {{workspace.branch}} too); it answers in the shape of sample

profile.description: With ai: a claude or codex profile of Settings › Agents & profiles (unset: Settings › Extensions’ agent)

source.description: Where its data comes from at first: the user picks another on its card (Own script, Static, File, URL, AI)

sample.description: Made-up data in the shape its data takes, for its preview before it runs (needed with a fetch, a script, a file or a URL)

sampleConfig.description: Settings to show the sample with

ui.description: What it draws with the UI kit (Settings › Extensions › UI kit, laki widget kit): one element, or { "preview", "full" }
